newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain ready to face all reforms quickly - Rato.
newsitem.headline: Spain ready to face all reforms quickly - Rato.

text.p: Spanish Economy Minister Rodrigo Rato said on Friday the government is ready to face as many deregulation measures as needed to develop the country's economy quickly.
"We'll make the necessary efforts to reform the economy, wherever it is needed and as quickly as we can," Rato told a seminar in Madrid.
The reforms are due to the high degree of maturity of Spanish society in the face of economic integration and globalisation, Rato said.
"We won't be content to stay at the average.. we are convinced that Spanish society is above average and a government has to be at the level of its society."
Spain has already taken steps to implement growth and fuel economic growth, in particular aimed at deregulating the property, telecommunications and energy sectors.
